properties.displayName: Account Created and Deleted in Short Timeframe - Entra ID
properties.description:
Pairs a user-account deletion with its earlier creation and surfaces the pair only when the short-lived account was actually used during its life: it signed in, or it was granted a directory role. A create/delete pair with no in-life activity is intended as lifecycle churn. Shortness of life and a single human actor running the whole create-then-delete lifecycle add weight through additive scoring.

TABLES: AuditLogs, SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
CONNECTORS: Microsoft Entra ID (AuditLogs, SignInLogs, NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs)
LICENSE: Microsoft Sentinel

TUNING:
1. DetectionWindow - recent deletions that trigger evaluation; align to run frequency.
2. LookbackWindow - how far back to find the matching creation and any in-life activity.
3. VeryShortLife / ShortLife - the two lifetime tiers that feed LifeWeight.
4. PrivilegedRoleOps - directory-role operations that count as escalation; extend for privileged groups, app consent or credential adds if those paths matter.
5. W_* weights and ScoreThreshold - shift to fit your environment.

KNOWN FALSE POSITIVES:
1. Provisioning or HR-sync rollbacks - created and deleted with no activity.
2. B2B guest invited and removed without signing in - no activity.
3. Admin error: account created, used briefly, removed same day - low volume, expected.

INVESTIGATION STEPS:
1. Confirm the pair is one identity: same UserId across CreationTime and DeletionTime.
2. Read RiskIndicators to see which signals fired (activity, tier, same actor).
3. If RoleGrantedDuringLife, inspect RoleOps and treat as escalation until cleared.
4. If SignedInDuringLife, review SignInIPs and SignInCount for the source and volume.
5. Compare CreatedByUser and DeletedByUser; a single human running both is higher concern.
6. Correlate CreatedByIP / DeletedByIP with known admin infrastructure.

BLIND SPOTS: Only catches accounts deleted within DetectionWindow whose creation and activity fall inside LookbackWindow; a delete outside the run window or an older-than-Lookback creation is missed. Non-role privilege paths (group membership, app consent, credential adds) are not scored. Activity via other data sources than sign-in or role grant is not evaluated.

Author: Bartosz Wysocki | https://www.itprofessor.cloud
Version: 1.0 | 2026-06-17

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Account {{TargetUPN}} lived {{Lifetime}} and showed activity before deletion. Indicators: {{RiskIndicators}}.
